items.html: Also with this you will understand what is said in the Tikunim, page 103: “Shema'na de-Ovada hava be-had bar nash, ba'alei Kabin, etc.” [We heard that there was an incident with a certain man, an owner of Kabin, etc.], and its explanation is as said above. For ZA has this Kav from the filling of the three Names AB, SAG, MA, which is within him, as above; and this Kav is also the gematria of Elokeinu [our God], and because it is from the aspect of fillings, it is judgments, for the filling is the gematria of Elokim, as above. And these are the seven kings who reigned in the land of Edom, and they all died and descended below, and were clarified there. And they stand there in the aspect of spirituality and Neshama for the shells.
